name: Owen of @onlypens_by_owen
bio: Straight out of the beautiful Port Macquarie Owen the founder of "Only Pens by Owen" and regular on Instagram shared his amazing story of making pens from the Huon Pine offcuts of the STS Yougn Endeavour II.

name: The Original Yellow Wiggle - Mr. Greg Page
bio: Greg the "original" Yellow Wiggle sat down with the boys to chat on a serious topic of Heart Health and relayed his story of survival and recovery from Cardiac Arrest in our Heartwood segment. An amazing man and story not to be missed.
